old_problem: The case points to an unavailable specification and supplies no switch-board identity, topology, safe transaction or expected response. DeepSeek's global scan neither selects the SW_BD mux branch nor distinguishes switch management, EEPROM and sensor endpoints; it can touch unrelated live buses and discards output.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and BLOCKED. The SW_BD label does not identify which controller and mux branch reaches the intended switch board or which identity/status fields are safe. A runtime parameter cannot safely choose among live switch-control, EEPROM and sensor endpoints or create a PASS oracle. The board/revision-specific sideband contract, fabric-health boundary and independent recovery are core prerequisites.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1801, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/blocked analyses and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1802 / Wistron-HW-00004-V003 / b2620ccfe91669e8.
I2C is BMC/platform-management scope by default; SW_BD must be reached through a documented BMC/OOB controller and mux branch, not inferred from host adapter numbering.
The same numerical address on another mux branch is a different device. A global address scan cannot prove switch-board identity, BOM coverage or safe access.
ED-03 prohibits guessed OEM parameters and ED-15 prohibits PASS without the approved response and switch/fabric health oracle.
Switch control, EEPROM and sensor functions have different safety properties; reserved and live-transaction exclusions must come from the project/vendor contract.
No SSH, I2C, switch, scan, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

Owning BMC/OOB controller, mux hierarchy/branch, bus and allowlisted addresses/device identities
Reserved, EEPROM/configuration and live-transaction exclusions plus exact permitted register/length/timeout semantics
Authoritative expected responses/masks and switch/fabric plus management health acceptance criteria
Approved tool/version, secure transport, maintenance window, independent console/BMC/switch recovery and owner
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED; perform no I2C access. After the complete switch-board contract and fresh review authorize execution, use verified secret-safe BMC/OOB access, select only the specified controller and mux branch, and read only the approved identity/status fields from allowlisted targets. Capture full untruncated raw responses and pre/post switch links/fabric, BMC SEL/SDR/sensors and OS health. test_case.expected_result: No executable PASS exists under current evidence. In a future authorized run, the specified mux branch and every allowlisted switch-board target must match the approved board-revision response matrix, with no extra/unknown access and no switch-link, fabric, management, BMC, sensor or OS health regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Current result is BLOCKED. Adapter/address enumeration alone cannot PASS. Future PASS requires exact board, path, allowed transaction and response matches plus clean switch/fabric and platform-health deltas. Missing contract, wrong branch, unexpected/missing device, response mismatch, unsafe operation, incomplete evidence or any link/management anomaly is FAIL/BLOCKED for owner verdict.
safety_gate: Do not infer SW_BD from host-visible bus numbering or probe an undocumented mux branch.
Do not access switch configuration or EEPROM command space or use force/write-capable transactions.
Use verified authentication, retain complete evidence and preserve switch, BMC and OS event history.
Stop on the first bus, link, fabric, management or sensor anomaly; do not retry or reset automatically.
expected_evidence: Approved SW_BD specification, board revision, BOM and response matrix
Controller/mux-branch/bus/address allowlist, exclusions and exact safe-read definition
Complete authenticated command/output transcript and per-target raw response comparison
Before/after switch links/fabric state, BMC SEL/SDR/sensors and OS health
Abort/no-retry/recovery audit and switch/platform owner verdict
test_case.recovery: No action is authorized now. In a future authorized run, stop at the first mismatch or health change, preserve complete evidence and do not retry. Use the independent approved console/BMC/switch recovery path; reset a bus, mux or switch only when the vendor/project recovery procedure explicitly authorizes it.
